description:
Base bundle: several reads in one paid call. One paid call on Base that returns two results: the token verdict for a Base ERC-20 contract, and a Base wallet snapshot (native balance, nonce, contract or not, ten major token balances with USD). Returns: each named part service's own result, in one paid call, keyed by the part's name -- exactly what each part returns when bought alone; the call succeeds only when every part answers. It takes the union of the parts' query parameters.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/base_verdict_wallet_snapshot_bundle. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__base_verdict_wallet_snapshot_bundle
